info.name: SLNG Voice Agents Account Deepgram Nova 3 API
info.description:
Public API for managing Voice Agents, dispatching outbound calls, and creating web (non-telephony) sessions.

Base URL: `https://api.agents.slng.ai`


Contact Support:
 Name: SLNG Support
 Email: support@slng.ai

header.description: Target region override. Auto-selected if not provided.

formdata.description: Enable partial/interim transcription results for streaming.
Apply formatting to improve readability (dates, times, numbers, etc.).
Include filler words (uh, um) in transcript.
Input audio encoding. (This can only be one of linear16,flac,mulaw,amr-nb,amr-wb,opus,speex,mp3,mp4,webm,aac,ogg)
Input audio sample rate in Hz.
Time in milliseconds of silence between words before sending an UtteranceEnd message. Default is 1000ms, minimum 200ms, maximum 5000ms. Requires interim_results (enable_partials) to be true.
Supported English language code. (This can only be one of en,en-au,en-us,en-nz,en-gb,en-in)
